title: History of the Israeli-Palestinian Conflict
description: The century-long struggle over Palestine/Israel, from the origins of Zionism to the negotiated agreements emerging from the Oslo peace process. Major themes include: the processes and structures of nation-building and state-building; the role played by regional and international actors; the broader context of socio-economic changes; the possibilities of reconciliation.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 378, HIST 442, HIST 468 (if taken in the same topic), HIST 469 (if taken in the same topic).
recommendations: HSTR 112 or HSTR 112A, and HSTR 112B recommended prior to HSTR 378.
